title.narrative: NCA - Tranforming Agriculture Markets and Livelihoods

description.narrative:
The project aims to transform South Sudan's agricultural sector into a resilient, inclusive and market-driven system that enhances food security, livelihoods and econmic opprotunities for rural communities in Rumbek East, Yirol West and Bor Counties
The project areas are: Outcome 1: increased food production through gender-sensitive, climate-resilient and market focused practices Outcome 2: increased access and linkage to markets Outcome 3: increased access to credit and finacnes for farmers groups and cooperatives Outcome 4: strengthening smallholder agricultural value chains and building the economic resilience of women and youth
